utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can bring my copy on Thursday if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help a lot, thanks. I’ll see you Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can probably make it, as long as we keep the timing clear and don’t overbook the evening.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re definitely planning to be there if the timing stays clear?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, if the timing stays clear, I’m planning to be there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the book club. I think I saw something about it, but I missed the details — when is it again?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, it’s this Thursday evening, I think around 7. Sorry, I always mix up the time — I can double-check if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thursday at 7 works for me. Thanks — let me know if you double-check it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I think the book club should meet next week, and I can remind Ira about it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds good to me, just let me know what day you pick.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll pick next week and send you the day once I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, I’m a little late, but I’m in for book club if there’s still room.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, there’s still room. Glad you could make it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, glad to be here.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like that. Let’s set a simple time and keep it easy to follow.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — how about Tuesday at 7 at the library? I can tell a few more people and keep it nice and simple.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Tuesday at 7 at the library works for me.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: When is the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It’s next Tuesday evening at 7. Want me to bring the book list?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, please bring the book list.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I’d be happy to hear how the book club’s going. What are you all reading right now?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We’re reading *The Left Hand of Darkness* this week, and we’re meeting at the library on Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds perfect for Thursday. I’ve heard that one sparks good discussion, so I’m glad the library is hosting.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds lovely, Rosa. I can bring a few tea options and help pick the next book.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Mara. Let’s compare the tea options and settle on a book the whole group will enjoy.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, let’s lay out the teas and choose a book that gives everyone a good chance to enjoy it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring extra snacks for book club if we’re short.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, that covers it if we need them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, I’ll bring the snacks if it looks like we need them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the book club's been buzzing lately - I heard they picked a really good one this month.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Really? I might have to check it out, then.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, I hear they’ve got a lively pick this time. You should come by if you get the chance.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can help with that. What time is the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It's at 7:00 PM.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, I’ll keep that in mind. Is there anything else I should note about the meeting?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can make it Thursday if that works.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thursday works for me. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: How about 7:30?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, I’ll mention the book club plan to Jules.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks for looping me in — I’d love to hear what plan you mention to the book club.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I’ll mention the book club plan to Jules.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the book club. I missed the latest change, didn't I? What happened?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just a small scheduling mix-up. I can fill you in after the meeting.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it. I’ll wait for the update after the meeting.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the book club is meeting this week. Are you going, Gus?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I think I will. Sounds like a good week for it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I’m planning to go too. It should be a nice chance to catch up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Opal. I’ve got the book club list updated, and I’ll make sure everyone has the details before we meet.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, that should make it easy for everyone to stay on track.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect. I’ll send the details along so everyone stays in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the timing and who’s bringing what. Can we settle the details before people start showing up?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, let’s lock it down now. I’ll ask who’s bringing what and make sure everyone knows the timing before they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, that covers my main worry. I’ll feel better once we know the exact timing and who’s bringing each dish.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the book club is still on for tonight, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s still on unless someone said otherwise. Should I check whether the time or place changed?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the time and place are definitely unchanged?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me. What time were you thinking for book club?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: How about 7:30? I usually run a little late, so that gives me a cushion.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 7:30 works for me. I’ll plan on being there then.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the book club's meeting got moved, but I haven't gotten the new time yet. Did you hear anything more?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Not yet, but I’ll ask around and see if anyone got the new time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, just let me know if you hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the book club. I think I was supposed to bring something, but I may have forgotten what.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, I think it was snacks or drinks for the group. If you want, I can help you figure it out before you head over.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, good, snacks or drinks makes sense. I can grab something simple on the way so I don't show up empty-handed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, I can help with that after I check the school schedule. What time is the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What time works best?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That usually works for me after school, around 4:30.
